name: The Watching Dead: the Panoptic Gaze and Ideologic Zombies.
headline: The Watching Dead: the Panoptic Gaze and Ideologic Zombies.
description: The article explores the image of zombies in postmodern zombie films and literature, heightened state of awareness of the living watching themselves and the dead closely to become a form of panoticism, and constant surveillance to mirror social discipline and control evolution in a carceral system.
